parameters.content:
Shared health check v1.0.0

Receives a health.ping event, performs provider availability checks via the GuardianHub edge functions, and reports healthy/degraded/unavailable via the signed callback. Never reports healthy if a required check failed or was skipped.

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET||$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;const b=$json.body||'';const cb={run_id:b.run_id||'',agent_key:b.agent_key,company_id:b.company_id,event_type:b.event_type,status:'succeeded',result:{agent:'health-check',status:'degraded',message:'Health check scaffold — wire provider checks before production',checked_at:new Date().toISOString()}};const sig=s?crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(cb)).digest('hex'):'';return[{json:{callback:cb,signature:sig,timestamp:String(Date.now()),nonce:$json.headers['x-gh-nonce']||'',correlation_id:$json.headers['x-gh-correlation-id']||''}}];
